title: Tuas, Singapore
author: jerry-zou
text: A few photos from Tuas. The station sign, the long route across Singapore, and a barge out on the water. Sand piled up behind the fence.

photos.alt: A barge with excavators on the water, beside pale sand piles behind a wire fence in Tuas.
photos.caption: Across the fence.

photos.alt: The green EW31 Tuas Crescent station sign beneath a yellow and steel roof.
photos.caption: Tuas Crescent, EW31.

photos.alt: An East–West Line route map at Tuas Crescent, with destinations toward Pasir Ris and Changi Airport.
photos.caption: A long way across the map.
